notes.title: News of the fish world.
notes.content:
There was a massive collapse in the coin market! (which is good news for the fish) New course 1: 100

Sale felt-tip pens! All felt-tip pens on 100 pearls.

notes.title: Update 1.1 has come!
notes.content:
1) All the Enhancements purchased for your fish also affect the campaign mode.
2) Having failed the task, your fish will save the collected pearls and coins.
3) Added the ability to dodge.
4) Substituted backgrounds.
5) The cursor is changed.

notes.title: Visiting a doctor.
notes.content: Today, Umnyasha took your fish to the doctor and they all received an injection from gluttony. Now it will be easier for you to feed your fish :)
